title: WP84 Decision N: coherent alias to modular correlation

source.pool: all prime powers p^v<=N, including proper and repeated-base powers
source.operator: original finite-J compressed source; all closed lag paths, finite roots, endpoint intersections, global centering

prerequisites.scope: replay suites validate prior algebra and finite checks; they are not asymptotic signed estimates for Decision N

population.reflected_orientation: exact source conjugation/reflection, treated with inherited signs and filters

carrier_reduction.h: A-X*B is real, not assumed integral
carrier_reduction.identity: A/B=X+h/B exactly, even when X*B is nonintegral
carrier_reduction.pointwise: abs(exp(i*T*delta)-exp(2*pi*i*h/B)) <= 32*pi*exp(sqrt(L))/X for all sufficiently large X in abs(delta)<=L/M
carrier_reduction.aggregate_normalized_error: O_epsilon(X^(-1/2+2*epsilon)*exp(-epsilon*sqrt(L))) + smaller ceiling terms; o(1) for fixed 0<epsilon<1/4
carrier_reduction.uniformity: all admissible endpoints; complete singleton prime-power pool B<=N; all ordered prime-power factorizations; finite lag mass included

exact_modular_form.residue_weight: W_B(a,b) sums exact source weights over n1=a mod B, n2=b mod B and abs(n1*n2-XB)<=4*B*exp(sqrt(L)/2)
exact_modular_form.separability: not established; complete-DFT square-root bilinear bound cannot be applied to W_B
exact_modular_form.DFT_identity: sum_(y mod B)e((a-a')y/B)=B*1_(a=a' mod B), valid for every integer B
exact_modular_form.noncoprime: for B=p^v and s=min(v,v_p(n1*n2))<v, phase conductor p^(v-s); if s>=v, phase is 1; all such terms retained
exact_modular_form.general_matrix_bound: abs(sum_ab W_ab e(ab/B))<=B*||W||_F; no square-root bilinear saving follows

theorem_hypothesis_audit.needed_form: W_B(a,b)=u_B(a)*v_B(b), or a proved low-rank decomposition with paid coefficient norms
theorem_hypothesis_audit.source_status: FAIL/OPEN: the sharp product window and K_center depend on n1*n2; no such decomposition is proved

theorem_hypothesis_audit.needed_form: a source-preserving average over a separated frequency/modulus family with coefficients independent of the averaged frequency, plus paid completion and endpoint uniformity
theorem_hypothesis_audit.source_status: NOT ESTABLISHED: B is a prime-power source variable coupled to the product window and source weights; no admissible large-sieve transform or uniform endpoint conclusion is derived

theorem_hypothesis_audit.method: Type I/II or dispersion for bilinear prime sums
theorem_hypothesis_audit.needed_form: factorized coefficient sequences on controlled intervals and a decomposition retaining the thin n1*n2 window, prime-power terms, finite-J factors and endpoint kernel
theorem_hypothesis_audit.source_status: NOT ESTABLISHED: no source-matched decomposition with a paid error is available in this audit

absolute_dyadic_bound.uniformity: for each endpoint, after complete lag mass and original source weights are bounded absolutely
absolute_dyadic_bound.signed_saving_required: sigma > beta-1/2+epsilon*(1+beta), plus room for logarithmic/subpower losses

critical_block.cutoff: all three ranges lie below N for sufficiently large X
critical_block.required_cancellation: relative saving X^(-1/10-8*epsilon/5) with strictly greater power and losses paid

attempted_method.method: complete finite DFT bilinear inequality for separable residue weights
attempted_method.valid_hypothesis: weight W_B(a,b)=u(a)*v(b), or a separately proved controlled low-rank decomposition
attempted_method.actual_status: FAIL: coupled source weight has product-window and endpoint-dependent centered kernel; no such decomposition or paid completion is available
attempted_method.classification_scope: bounded no-go for this attempted route, not a counterexample and not a survey proving every method impossible

unproved: uniform signed modular correlation estimate for the original coupled prime-power weight
all remaining alias fringes/tails and other high-product sectors
remaining_populations: mixed first-alias outer fringes and larger-singleton tails

hostile_checks: replace full pool by ordinary primes/fixed R
average in T or endpoint index instead of uniform endpoint bound
